x: It was pleasing to note that the local press generously acknowledged the unique achievement of 4 Bels making the Surrey Youths Inter-Counties Team and great to see Dave North's name alongside those of many illustreous past winners including that of Bernie Ford!

On this method of scoring he placed none other than our own Gerry North in top spot followed closely by Bernie Ford. Bernie has still a good few Nationals in him and no doubt he will take over top spot in the next year or so.
Add to that music supplied by the popular 'Jaguars' and with the equally popular Ann and Bernie Ford as principal guests you have the formula for success.
M.Harris 24.13; S.Paton (Bels) 24.34. 2.S.Ovett 15.03; G.Adams (Bels) 16.33; 3.I.Cornford 24.29; F.Ward (Bels) 26.12; 4.J.Sherban 15.17; M.Forrester (Bels) 16.33; 5.B.Ford & B.
